```sql
create or replace table user_badge_{{ set }}_feats as -- noqa

with labels as materialized (
    {% if (set == 'train') and (subsample > 0) %} -- noqa
    select * from user_badge_{{ set }} using sample {{ subsample }} -- noqa
    {% else %}
    select * from user_badge_{{ set }} -- noqa
    {% endif %}
),

-- badge incidence computed only from badges available at each label timestamp
label_timestamps as (
    select distinct timestamp from labels
),

badge_freqs as (
    select
        label_timestamps.timestamp,
        badges.Name,
        count(*) / (sum(count(*)) over (partition by label_timestamps.timestamp)) as badge_incidence
    from label_timestamps
    join badges
        on badges.Date <= label_timestamps.timestamp
    group by label_timestamps.timestamp, badges.Name
),

badge_feats_deagged as (
    select
        labels.UserId,
        labels.timestamp,
        badges.Id,
        case
            when badge_freqs.badge_incidence >= 0.01 then badges.Name
            else 'OTHER'
        end as badge_name,
        log(1 / badge_freqs.badge_incidence) as rarity,
        date_diff('week', badges.Date, labels.timestamp) as badge_age_weeks,
        date_diff('day', badges.Date, labels.timestamp) as badge_age_days,
        badges.Class
    from labels
    join badges
        on badges.UserId = labels.UserId
        and badges.Date <= labels.timestamp
    join badge_freqs
        on badge_freqs.Name = badges.Name
        and badge_freqs.timestamp = labels.timestamp
),

badge_feats as (
    select
        UserId,
        timestamp,
        count(*) as badge_count,
        count(distinct Id) as badge_distinct_count,
        count(distinct badge_name) as badge_distinct_name_count,
        sum(case when badge_name = 'OTHER' then 1 else 0 end) as badge_other_count,
        sum(case when Class = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as badge_gold_count,
        sum(case when Class = 2 then 1 else 0 end) as badge_silver_count,
        sum(case when Class = 3 then 1 else 0 end) as badge_bronze_count,
        avg(rarity) as badge_rarity_avg,
        min(rarity) as badge_rarity_min,
        max(rarity) as badge_rarity_max,
        avg(badge_age_weeks) as badge_age_weeks_avg,
        min(badge_age_weeks) as badge_age_weeks_min,
        max(badge_age_weeks) as badge_age_weeks_max,
        min(badge_age_days) as badge_days_since_last,
        max(badge_age_days) as badge_days_since_first
    from badge_feats_deagged
    group by UserId, timestamp
),

-- comment features, only comments created at or before the label timestamp
comment_feats as (
    select
        labels.UserId,
        labels.timestamp,
        count(*) as comment_count,
        count(distinct comments.PostId) as comment_distinct_post_count,
        avg(comments.Score) as comment_score_avg,
        min(comments.Score) as comment_score_min,
        max(comments.Score) as comment_score_max,
        min(date_diff('day', comments.CreationDate, labels.timestamp)) as comment_days_since_last,
        max(date_diff('day', comments.CreationDate, labels.timestamp)) as comment_days_since_first
    from labels
    join comments
        on comments.UserId = labels.UserId
        and comments.CreationDate <= labels.timestamp
    group by labels.UserId, labels.timestamp
),

-- post features, only posts created at or before the label timestamp
post_feats as (
    select
        labels.UserId,
        labels.timestamp,
        count(*) as post_count,
        count(distinct posts.Id) as post_distinct_count,
        sum(case when posts.PostTypeId = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as question_count,
        sum(case when posts.PostTypeId = 2 then 1 else 0 end) as answer_count,
        avg(posts.Score) as post_score_avg,
        max(posts.Score) as post_score_max,
        sum(posts.Score) as post_score_sum,
        sum(posts.FavoriteCount) as post_favorite_count_sum,
        sum(posts.ViewCount) as post_view_count_sum,
        avg(posts.AnswerCount) as post_answer_count_avg,
        min(date_diff('day', posts.CreationDate, labels.timestamp)) as post_days_since_last,
        max(date_diff('day', posts.CreationDate, labels.timestamp)) as post_days_since_first
    from labels
    join posts
        on posts.OwnerUserId = labels.UserId
        and posts.CreationDate <= labels.timestamp
    group by labels.UserId, labels.timestamp
),

-- vote features, only votes created at or before the label timestamp
vote_feats as (
    select
        labels.UserId,
        labels.timestamp,
        count(*) as vote_count,
        count(distinct votes.PostId) as vote_distinct_post_count,
        sum(case when votes.VoteTypeId = 2 then 1 else 0 end) as upvote_given_count,
        sum(case when votes.VoteTypeId = 3 then 1 else 0 end) as downvote_given_count,
        min(date_diff('day', votes.CreationDate, labels.timestamp)) as vote_days_since_last,
        max(date_diff('day', votes.CreationDate, labels.timestamp)) as vote_days_since_first
    from labels
    join votes
        on votes.UserId = labels.UserId
        and votes.CreationDate <= labels.timestamp
    group by labels.UserId, labels.timestamp
),

-- post history features, only history rows created at or before the label timestamp
history_feats as (
    select
        labels.UserId,
        labels.timestamp,
        count(*) as posthistory_count,
        count(distinct postHistory.PostId) as posthistory_distinct_post_count,
        min(date_diff('day', postHistory.CreationDate, labels.timestamp)) as posthistory_days_since_last
    from labels
    join posts
        on posts.OwnerUserId = labels.UserId
    join postHistory
        on postHistory.PostId = posts.Id
        and postHistory.CreationDate <= labels.timestamp
    group by labels.UserId, labels.timestamp
),

-- post link features, only links created at or before the label timestamp
link_feats as (
    select
        labels.UserId,
        labels.timestamp,
        count(*) as postlink_count,
        sum(case when postLinks.LinkTypeId = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as postlink_related_count,
        sum(case when postLinks.LinkTypeId = 3 then 1 else 0 end) as postlink_duplicate_count
    from labels
    join posts
        on posts.OwnerUserId = labels.UserId
    join postLinks
        on postLinks.PostId = posts.Id
        and postLinks.CreationDate <= labels.timestamp
    group by labels.UserId, labels.timestamp
)

select
    labels.user_id as UserId,
    labels.timestamp,
    coalesce(badge_feats.badge_count, 0) as badge_count,
    coalesce(badge_feats.badge_distinct_count, 0) as badge_distinct_count,
    coalesce(badge_feats.badge_distinct_name_count, 0) as badge_distinct_name_count,
    coalesce(badge_feats.badge_other_count, 0) as badge_other_count,
    coalesce(badge_feats.badge_gold_count, 0) as badge_gold_count,
    coalesce(badge_feats.badge_silver_count, 0) as badge_silver_count,
    coalesce(badge_feats.badge_bronze_count, 0) as badge_bronze_count,
    badge_feats.badge_rarity_avg,
    badge_feats.badge_rarity_min,
    badge_feats.badge_rarity_max,
    badge_feats.badge_age_weeks_avg,
    badge_feats.badge_age_weeks_min,
    badge_feats.badge_age_weeks_max,
    badge_feats.badge_days_since_last,
    badge_feats.badge_days_since_first,
    coalesce(comment_feats.comment_count, 0) as comment_count,
    coalesce(comment_feats.comment_distinct_post_count, 0) as comment_distinct_post_count,
    comment_feats.comment_score_avg,
    comment_feats.comment_score_min,
    comment_feats.comment_score_max,
    comment_feats.comment_days_since_last,
    comment_feats.comment_days_since_first,
    coalesce(post_feats.post_count, 0) as post_count,
    coalesce(post_feats.post_distinct_count, 0) as post_distinct_count,
    coalesce(post_feats.question_count, 0) as question_count,
    coalesce(post_feats.answer_count, 0) as answer_count,
    post_feats.post_score_avg,
    post_feats.post_score_max,
    coalesce(post_feats.post_score_sum, 0) as post_score_sum,
    coalesce(post_feats.post_favorite_count_sum, 0) as post_favorite_count_sum,
    coalesce(post_feats.post_view_count_sum, 0) as post_view_count_sum,
    post_feats.post_answer_count_avg,
    post_feats.post_days_since_last,
    post_feats.post_days_since_first,
    coalesce(vote_feats.vote_count, 0) as vote_count,
    coalesce(vote_feats.vote_distinct_post_count, 0) as vote_distinct_post_count,
    coalesce(vote_feats.upvote_given_count, 0) as upvote_given_count,
    coalesce(vote_feats.downvote_given_count, 0) as downvote_given_count,
    vote_feats.vote_days_since_last,
    vote_feats.vote_days_since_first,
    coalesce(history_feats.posthistory_count, 0) as posthistory_count,
    coalesce(history_feats.posthistory_distinct_post_count, 0) as posthistory_distinct_post_count,
    history_feats.posthistory_days_since_last,
    coalesce(link_feats.postlink_count, 0) as postlink_count,
    coalesce(link_feats.postlink_related_count, 0) as postlink_related_count,
    coalesce(link_feats.postlink_duplicate_count, 0) as postlink_duplicate_count
from labels
left join badge_feats
    on badge_feats.UserId = labels.UserId
    and badge_feats.timestamp = labels.timestamp
left join comment_feats
    on comment_feats.UserId = labels.UserId
    and comment_feats.timestamp = labels.timestamp
left join post_feats
    on post_feats.UserId = labels.UserId
    and post_feats.timestamp = labels.timestamp
left join vote_feats
    on vote_feats.UserId = labels.UserId
    and vote_feats.timestamp = labels.timestamp
left join history_feats
    on history_feats.UserId = labels.UserId
    and history_feats.timestamp = labels.timestamp
left join link_feats
    on link_feats.UserId = labels.UserId
    and link_feats.timestamp = labels.timestamp
```
